name: Včelná (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a yellow stripe into a blue upper hoist part and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 March 2000 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
